priorities.title: CSA CCM 4.1.0
priorities.reason: Cloud customer/provider responsibilities and assurance. Obtain the official CCM under its publisher terms before importing requirements.

priorities.title: ISO 27017:2015
priorities.reason: Cloud security responsibilities. Acquire licensed ISO text; SCF references do not license the standard or replace its requirements.

priorities.title: ISO 27018:2025
priorities.reason: Personal data in public cloud. Acquire the current licensed standard from ISO or an authorised distributor.

priorities.title: AICPA TSC 2017:2022
priorities.reason: Provider assurance: obtain the criteria and each supplier’s assurance report; a SOC 2 report is entity-specific, not a generic certificate.

priorities.title: NIST SP 800-207
priorities.reason: Cloud and hybrid zero-trust architecture; complements the existing CISA maturity model.

priorities.title: ISO 27001:2022
priorities.reason: Management-system assurance. Obtain licensed publisher text; do not infer certification from control overlap.

priorities.title: ISO 27002:2022
priorities.reason: General controls guidance. Obtain licensed publisher text before a full requirements import.

priorities.title: ASD Essential Eight
priorities.reason: WACC imports the current publisher page labelled November 2023. SCF labels its column 2024; no automatic transfer of these mappings.

priorities.title: ASD ISM
priorities.reason: WACC uses September 2026; SCF uses March 2026. Compare changes before accepting SCF mappings.

priorities.title: CIS Controls
priorities.reason: WACC uses v8; SCF uses v8.1. The Microsoft workbook’s v8 references are kept separate.

priorities.title: NIST CSF 2.0
priorities.reason: Same named edition. SCF cross-references remain publisher assertions, not compliance determinations.

priorities.title: NIST SP 800-53 R5
priorities.reason: SCF names R5 without WACC’s 5.2.0 minor revision. No automatic SCF-to-800-53 links are imported.
